summary: Haatch is an operator-led UK investor that says it backs UK founders early, at pre-seed and seed, in B2B software across the future of enterprise, fintech and vertical SaaS, targeting minimum annual contracts of £12,000. Its site reports 197 active portfolio companies and £155,000,000 raised and invested to date across SEIS, EIS and syndicate funds. Founders pitch through a linked form. Cheque size and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.
